title: Task-generation result document (task_generation_result.json)
description: The document a task_generation subagent prints and the invoker persists under the phase dir. Validated before anything is written to the plan; the semantic rules utils/task_decomposer.py owns (unique T### ids, depends_on naming only declared ids, acyclic, at least one dependency-free task) run in Python immediately after this schema check. A document that fails either is a schema_invalid failure; the executor lane re-asks the runner once with the validator's errors (the retry ladder's rule 7), and nothing else retries it.

plan_preamble.description: 3-5 sentences of shared context injected into every task prompt. Required, and non-empty: the task_generation reply contract emits it unconditionally, and a document that omits it would validate cleanly while every downstream implement prompt silently loses its shared context.

subagent_type.description: Optional Claude-Code-only metadata, so required-but-nullable: OpenAI's strict structured-output subset needs every property in `required` (measured 2026-10-01: codex declined this schema on `subagent_type` alone), and null is how a reply says it has none. The invoker supplies null when a reply leaves the key out (subagent_executor.normalize_result). When non-null it must agree with executor_role; that rule lives in task_decomposer.validate_generated_tasks because OpenAI's strict subset does not list allOf/if/then (the former allOf here is gone, not weakened).
